SELECT cs.id, cs.name, cs.category_id, cs.config, c.slug as category_slug
FROM content_sources cs
JOIN categories c ON cs.category_id = c.id
WHERE cs.source_type IN ('youtube_channel', 'youtube_search')
AND cs.is_active = true
SELECT id FROM content WHERE external_id = '{{$json["external_id"]}}' AND source = 'youtube'
UPDATE content_sources SET last_fetched_at = NOW() WHERE id = '{{$node["Get Active YouTube Sources"].json["id"]}}'
